values: 对敌人造成伤害并为其种下“吮噬心核”，“吮噬心核”会每隔一段时间攻击宿主并扣除他的能量。
Saida teleports to an enemy and plants a Drain Seed in them. The Drain Seed periodically deals damage to the host and reduces their Energy.

悉达瞬移到敌人面前，使其无法行动，对其造成共520% + 60% ATK伤害并吸收共220 + 20点能量，期间悉达处于霸体状态，随后在敌人身上种下“吮噬心核”。本技能优先对未种下“吮噬心核”的敌人使用。当“吮噬心核”的宿主被击败或悉达为已种下“吮噬心核”的敌人再次释放终极技能时，这枚“吮噬心核”会掉落在场上，且场上至多同时存在8个“吮噬心核”，在挑战首领的模式中，掉落在场上的“吮噬心核”不会阻挡角色。
被动地，每2.5秒，“吮噬心核”对宿主造成250% ATK伤害，并扣除敌人120点能量。

Active. Saida teleports in front of an enemy, preventing them from moving or acting. She then deals 520% + 60% ATK damage and drains 220 + 20 Energy from the enemy. Saida remains unaffected while doing this and plants a Drain Seed in the enemy. She prioritizes enemies without a Drain Seed.
This seed drops to the ground if its host is defeated or if Saida uses her Ultimate on its host again. Up to 8 Drain Seeds can exist on the battlefield at the same time. In boss fights, Drain Seeds on the ground will not obstruct unit movement.
Passive. Every 2.5s, Drain Seed deals 250% ATK damage to its host and reduces their Energy by 120.
Increases the skill damage to 540% + 60% ATK.
Increases the skill damage to 560% + 60% ATK.
Increases the skill damage to 580% + 60% ATK.
Increases the skill damage to 600% + 60% ATK.
被动地，造成伤害时会回复一定生命值，且溢出回复会转化为护盾；主动释放时，对敌人造成伤害，并且附近的“吮噬心核”也会一同对敌人造成伤害。

Passive. Saida restores HP when she deals damage. Any excess healing from this effect is converted into a shield.
Active. Saida deals damage to an enemy, commanding nearby Drain Seeds to deal damage to the same enemy.

被动地，悉达的普通攻击和技能造成伤害时，会额外回复等同于100%实际造成伤害量的生命值，且通过这个方式获得的生命回复时，超出生命上限的部分将会转化为护盾，该护盾的抵御值不会超过3000% + 300% ATK。
主动释放时，将血刺刺入敌人体内，对其造成420% + 40% ATK伤害并造成打断效果。若该敌人1格范围内存在“吮噬心核”，则会进行一次协同攻击，对其造成30% ATK伤害。

Passive. Saida restores extra HP equal to 100% of the damage dealt by her normal attacks and skills. Any excess healing from this effect is converted into a shield. The shield value cannot exceed 3000% + 300% ATK.
Active. Saida forms a blood spike to pierce an enemy, dealing 420% + 40% ATK damage and interrupting their action. If any Drain Seeds are within 1 tile of the enemy, each one also forms blood spikes to strike that enemy, dealing 30% ATK damage.
被击败时，消耗掉一枚“吮噬心核”重新复生。
When Saida is defeated, she consumes a Drain Seed to revive.
悉达被击败时，会消耗掉一枚“吮噬心核”，在其所处位置重新复生，并回复10% + 1% HP。本技能优先消耗存活最久的“吮噬心核”，且其每存活1秒，使悉达复生时额外回复2.5% HP，至多额外回复50% HP。

When Saida is defeated, she consumes a Drain Seed to revive at the seed's position, restoring 10% + 1% HP HP. She prioritizes the oldest seed available and restores an extra 2.5% HP HP for each second the consumed seed existed. The extra HP restored cannot exceed 50% HP.
“吮噬心核”每存活1秒，使悉达复生时额外回复3% HP，至多额外回复60% HP。
Saida restores an extra 3% HP HP for each second the consumed seed existed. The extra HP restored cannot exceed 60% HP.
“吮噬心核”每存活1秒，使悉达复生时额外回复3.5% HP，至多额外回复70% HP。
Saida restores an extra 3.5% HP HP for each second the consumed seed existed. The extra HP restored cannot exceed 70% HP.
“吮噬心核”每存活1秒，使悉达复生时额外回复4% HP，至多额外回复80% HP。
Saida restores an extra 4% HP HP for each second the consumed seed existed. The extra HP restored cannot exceed 80% HP.
战斗中，受到伤害降低，每有1枚“吮噬心核”存活则受到伤害进一步降低。
Saida reduces her damage taken during battle. She further reduces her damage taken for each existing Drain Seed.
战斗中，自身的受到的伤害降低12%，每有1枚“吮噬心核”存活，受到伤害额外降低2%，至多额外降低10%。
Saida reduces her damage taken by 12% during battle. She further reduces her damage taken by an extra 2% for each existing Drain Seed, up to a maximum of 10%.
战斗中，自身的受到的伤害降低16%，每有1枚“吮噬心核”存活，受到伤害额外降低3%，至多额外降低15%。
Saida reduces her damage taken by 16% during battle. She further reduces her damage taken by an extra 3% for each existing Drain Seed, up to a maximum of 15%.
战斗中，自身的受到的伤害降低20%，每有1枚“吮噬心核”存活，受到伤害额外降低4%，至多额外降低20%。
Saida reduces her damage taken by 20% during battle. She further reduces her damage taken by an extra 4% for each existing Drain Seed, up to a maximum of 20%.
每次释放终极技能，提升“吮噬心核”的攻击频率。
Saida shortens the interval between Drain Seed attack effects each time she uses her Ultimate.
被“吮噬心核”寄生的敌人造成的伤害降低35%。悉达每释放1次终极技能，使本场战斗中“吮噬心核”攻击宿主的间隔降低0.5秒，至多降低1.5秒。

Saida reduces the damage dealt by enemies afflicted with a Drain Seed by 35%. Each time she casts her Ultimate, the interval between Drain Seed attack effects is shortened by 0.5s, up to a maximum reduction of 1.5s for the current battle.
“吮噬心核”造成伤害提升至290% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt by Drain Seeds to 290% ATK.
“吮噬心核”造成伤害提升至330% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt by Drain Seeds to 330% ATK.
本技能降低“吮噬心核”攻击间隔的效果达到上限后，悉达对所有敌人造成1200% ATK伤害，并用血刺缠绕使他们无法行动。血刺会在敌人处于霸体期间缩回，并会在霸体结束后继续缠绕，且缠绕期间敌人每秒失去160% ATK的生命值。每名敌人缠绕的总时长至多为45秒。

When Saida has shortened the interval between Drain Seed's attack effects to its limit with Deepening Roots, she deals 1200% ATK damage to all enemies and traps them with blood spikes, preventing them from moving or acting. If an enemy becomes unaffected, they are temporarily freed, but the trap resumes once the unaffected effect ends. Each enemy is always trapped for a total of 45s, losing 160% ATK HP per second while trapped.
在战斗开始时，在周围的友军身上种下“吮噬心核”。
When a battle starts, Saida plants Drain Seeds in nearby allies.
在战斗开始时，在离自身最近的2名友方英雄身上种下“吮噬心核”，它们不会对友军发起攻击，并会在战斗开始时使这些友军获得抵御值为悉达的800% ATK的护盾。
When a battle starts, Saida plants Drain Seeds in 2 nearby allied heroes. These seeds do not harm allies but grant them a shield that can absorb 800% ATK damage.
